label: Three pins and the median point
section: Three pins and the median point
subgoals: Take the median x and median y as the Steiner point
Connect each pin to it with monotone wires
Read the length as the bounding-box half-perimeter

label: Exact search for small nets
subgoals: Enumerate sets of at most n - 2 candidate Hanan points
Compute the MST of the pins plus each set
Take the minimum over all sets as the RSMT

label: Savings and hardness
subgoals: Subtract the RSMT length from the MST length
Expect savings of about ten percent and at most one third
Use heuristics for large nets because the problem is NP-hard
